thread:
Anya: quick heads-up — during the int4 canary for v2p1-lite we started to see a small but consistent long-doc regression on the news/longform slice. MRR -3.2% vs baseline, hallucination rate +0.8%. :warning:
Mike: ugh. sample size? is this noise or real? :eyes:
Anya: ~12k requests in the window (10% canary), p-value ~0.02 for MRR delta. here's the aggregated snippet:
```
slice: longform/news
baseline: v2p1 (fp16)
variant: v2p1-int4
n: 11890
mrr_delta: -0.032
halluc_rate_delta: +0.008
p_mrr: 0.019
p_halluc: 0.045
```
Julia: thanks — looks credible. which prompt cohorts are worst (summarization vs QG)?
Anya: mostly multi-paragraph summarization and instruction-following with long context (>8k). short Q/A is fine.
Nate: plausible cause is attentive quantization error accumulating across long KV cache. we saw similar in earlier nf4 experiments but smaller magnitude.
Mike: what's the current canary percent?
deploy-bot: Canary updated: v2p1-int4 -> 10% traffic at 2026-03-18T13:07:54Z
Anya: 10% now. recommend pausing rollout until we scope mitigations. propose thresholds: auto-fallback if MRR drop >1.5% AND p < 0.05 OR halluc_rate_delta >0.5% absolute. thoughts?
Julia: +1 to a two-signal rule (quality + stat significance). add slice-weighting so a high-impact slice (longform) can trigger earlier.
Nate: can we try hybrid route: route long-docs to fp16 variant, keep others on int4. quick routing rule by seq_len > 4k. cheap to implement in A/B router.
Mike: good call. also run a small focused shadow on longform with kv-cache warm starts to see if warmup helps.
Anya: action items: 1) Nate to prototype router rule and warmup shadow (ETA 4h). 2) Julia to assemble per-slice delta dashboard and add slice weights (ETA EOD). 3) I'll hold canary and flip auto-fallback thresholds to conservative values in config.
Nate: will post PR for router rule, include quick perf check (`/routes set seq_len_cutoff=4096 fp16_route=longform`).
Julia: adding test slices now. will notify when dashboard hits 100% of samples.
Mike: thanks team — let's avoid a noisy rollback. tag me @mike if we hit the auto-fallback. :thumbsup:
Anya: noted. keeping thread open for updates.
deploy-bot: Auto-fallback rule updated: mrr_threshold=0.015, halluc_threshold=0.005, require_p<=0.05 for mrr trigger.
Anya: perfect — closing the loop when router PR lands.
